items.title_en: Essentials: Manage Stress & Build Resilience | Dr. Elissa Epel
items.title_cn: Essentials: Manage Stress & Build Resilience | Dr. Elissa Epel
items.desc_en:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Elissa Epel, PhD, a Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF). We discuss how acute and chronic stress affect the body and brain, including their links to cellular aging and mitochondrial health. We also explain tools to reduce rumination, reframe stress as a challenge and build resilience, as well as how radical acceptance and a sense of purpose can help us navigate stressors we cannot change.

Show notes: https://go.hubermanlab.com/fqVKGyP

items.title_en: Bringing Extinct Species Back to Life | Dr. Beth Shapiro
items.title_cn: Bringing Extinct Species Back to Life | Dr. Beth Shapiro
items.desc_en:
Dr. Beth Shapiro, PhD, is an evolutionary biologist and Chief Science Officer at @Colossal Biosciences. Her work focuses on de-extinction and wildlife conservation efforts. We discuss genetic differences among humans, and how ancient DNA and modern embryology are being used to de-extinct and protect woolly mammoths, dodo birds, and dire wolves, as well as to help conserve endangered species. We also explore the ethical implications of de-extinction and how synthetic biology can help build a more bio diverse and resilient world.

Show notes: https://go.hubermanlab.com/JKtj3zr
